title: Kissed Crumbly French Tomato Crepes
description: A cozy French dish featuring canned tomatoes and toast, wrapped in a low-glycemic-friendly crepe, this recipe is perfect for a satisfying meal. The combination of crumbly texture and resinous flavor will leave you wanting more.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, eggs, and melted butter to make the crepe batter.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and pour a small amount of batter to make a thin crepe.
Cook the crepe for 1-2 minutes on each side until lightly browned and set aside.
Repeat the process to make 8 crepes in total.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chopped canned tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
Cook the tomato mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has reduced and the mixture is thickened.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked crepe on a plate, spoon some tomato mixture in the center, and top with crumbled whole wheat bread and feta cheese.
Fold the crepe in half to enclose the filling and serve immediately.
Repeat the process to assemble the remaining crepes.
